jobs.description: WANTED: The Worlds Most Creative Remote/Virtual Meta Ads UGC Creator When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: I actually read the instructions. One is a computer science nerd turned English teacher who used to work on top secret projects for the US military but prefers to teach English as a second language to foreigners. Is that you? Check out our app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.perfectprep.pwa Who We Are Looking For We are looking for a highly talented UGC Creator to create 10 final cut video ads for Paid Meta ads. These ads will be advertised in India targeting people who are planning on taking the IELTS exam. The right UGC Creator needs to understand performance-ad structure well enough to take a briefan audience, a funnel stage, an emotional insight pulled from real customer researchand turn it into an ad that actually earns attention and holds it. They don't set the campaign strategy or decide which angles we test. Instead, they act as a creatorturning raw insight and voice-of-customer material into UGC, product-demo, or any other video and copy that gets people interested enough to click through, visit our app store listing, and ultimately download the app. In summary, you are a kick ass ad creator. This role requires a unique mix of right brain work (hook-writing, pacing, visual storytelling); and left brain work (understanding whether a given ad's job is to earn attention, build trust, or close doubtand understanding hook rate, hold rate, and click-through well enough to know if it worked). Whether you're the one on camera, or it's your partner, your friend, or your siblingthat's up to you. Whether you film on a phone or a DSLR camera, edit in Adobe or CapCutthat's all up to you too. We care about the effectiveness of the ads, not how you got there. We see effective ads as an essential part of our growth engine, and we're looking for an amazing UGC Creator to help us reach more IELTS students around the world! The Key Responsibilities: 10 final video ads with captions delivered within 7 days from hire date. Achieve an Average Meta Hook rate of at least 30% across all videos. Upload ad creative and raw footage to our company drive. Qualifications: Passionate about video storytelling and connecting with audiences. Strong understanding of both trends and audience behavior on social media. Willing to learn and adapt to new platforms & strategies. Pay & Growth Opportunities: This project pays 105,600 for 10 distinct videos. 50% of payment will be paid upfront. The remainder will be paid out after the final completion of the batch. You'll start producing content within our existing pillars, with an experienced strategist briefing you before the ads are produced. You'll be given a fair amount of creative freedom. Our strategist will give you the message. How you communicate that message will be up to you. You will be responsible for scripting, shooting, and editing the videos. You'll be graded and considered for additional projects based on how your content actually performs (hook rate, hold rate, and whether it earns sustained ad spend). Growth opportunities Our hope is that this first batch of ads is not the last time we work with you, and that we can build an ongoing relationship for regular ad creative. If our Meta approach proves out, you'll be the first one we turn to for expanding into other platforms (TikTok, YouTube, and beyond!). As the app grows into new markets (Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines, and more) you'll be first in line to help us take those on. This could be by creating more content yourself, but more likely it will be by offering you a creative manager role. Make Sure You're Comfortable With... Remote working: This is a remote (work-from-home) position. If you dont have a reliable way to produce video content and access to an internet connection in order to upload it, this isnt the right role for you. We work on tight deadlines and last-minute changes are common. If youre not comfortable with fast turnarounds and constructive feedback, this role might not suit you. This is not yet a full time position but a hire as needed position. You will be hired and compensated for this first batch of ads, but after that there will be no additional work until another batch is needed (or we start to launch on other platforms or in other countries). 1 Year of paid ad usage rights, plus access to all raw footage, and up to 2 revisions per video are all included in our price. Successful UGC Creator Personality Profile There is never only one "right way" to do a job. But certain patterns are common. People who do well in this role often share these traits: They enjoy finding patterns and trying new ideas quickly. Every ad is a test, not a finished piece of art. They are comfortable being wrong often, because success does not mean "this looks nice." Success means "this made a stranger stop, pay attention, and take action." They also have a special skill: connecting with people they do not know the same way a musician connects with listeners through a song, or a painter connects with a stranger through a picture. They understand feelings like fear, hope, pride, and worry. And they know how to put those feelings into a video or message so a stranger feels it too. This is not only a technical skill. It comes from caring about real people, and from really listening when people talk about their problems. They care more about real people than about perfect, polished production. They would rather make ten simple, different ideas than one beautiful version of the same idea. What energizes top performers in this role: Fast feedback (seeing real results quickly not waiting weeks to know if something worked) Variety (a new idea, a new style, never repeating the same concept) Freedom (trust to do the work in their own way, not a strict process) Real, honest human stories Clear numbers that answer the question, instead of opinions in a meeting If you're interested, please submit the following: 1) A link to your resume in PDF format with links to social content you have done in the past. The PDF MUST follow naming convention: Lastname.Firstname.META-ADS-CREATOR.pdf 2) Your answer to this question: If you were an animal, what animal would you be and why? 3) Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally: "Do unto others as you would have them do unto you."? 4) A link to a short video that tells us about your experience and why you think youd be a good fit for this project. Submissions should go to: jesse.reyes+hiring@perfectprep.ai As you can tell, were eager to find the best candidate for this project. If theres something about the position or even the instructions that dont make sense, please dont hesitate to reach out. Im happy to answer any questions, just include them in your application.
